title: Bright color text on minecraft server console look thicker then normal color text
body:
### What Operating System(s) are you seeing this problem on?

Windows

### Which Wayland compositor or X11 Window manager(s) are you using?

_No response_

### WezTerm version

wezterm 20221119-145034-49b9839f

### Did you try the latest nightly build to see if the issue is better (or worse!) than your current version?

Yes, and I updated the version box above to show the version of the nightly that I tried

### Describe the bug

i  used to use Windows Terminal, MobaXterm, Alacritty and Wezterm to run Minecraft server, and i noticed that with Wezterm and Alacritty bright text display on Minecraft server console (maybe java console in general?)  look thicker  than normal color text, but in linux shell console it look corectly.

Sorry for bad English, and this is image:
![compare](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12563466/211273959-eb22a21d-3422-4e8d-8630-786de706a01b.png)

If Wezterm can't find configured font and used fallback font then text look normal and equal every where. This is when fallback font is used:
![fallback-font](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12563466/211276925-48ff9e56-d5c7-43ae-8579-d3974df282a6.png)

Text display in Windows Terminal and MobaXterm all look perfect.
![window-terminal](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12563466/211277921-be441845-4cf4-4165-994e-a45fbc4512d7.png)

        Print("[00:17:10 INFO]: ")
        Action(CSI(Sgr(Foreground(PaletteIndex(5)))))
        Action(CSI(Sgr(Intensity(Bold))))

```

so these are ansi palette indices 0-7 + bold which translates to using the bright version (palette indices 8-15) because of https://wezfurlong.org/wezterm/config/lua/config/bold_brightens_ansi_colors.html

I'd expect these to appear as both bold and brighter than the the non-light versions.

Please download the trimmed recording and run:

```
wezterm replay wezterm-recording-2932-trimmed.txt 
```

and attach a screenshot of how that renders, so that I can see it.

comments.body:
It is bold; the recording you provided sets the color and then sets bold. That is how bright colors are/were set for an 8-color terminal; by setting them bold.

Other terminals may choose to render this kind of bold/bright differently, but this is how wezterm renders it: by making it bright and by using a bold variant of the font.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
It is definitely bold. In your fallback scenario, it looks like you have a font_rule that uses the regular weight JetBrains Mono font when bold text is selected, which is why it doesn't appear bold.

I've pushed a commit that will allow you to set:

```lua
 bold_brightens_ansi_colors = "BrightOnly",
```

the effect of setting that is that when text is bold + ANSI color palette 0-7, wezterm will add 8 to the palette index for color selection (shifting it to the bright range), and treat it as though it was not bold for font selection.

That change should be available in the nightly build in about an hour.
